final: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), total AS (SELECT SUM(race_count) AS total_count FROM circuit_counts), shares AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.race_count, CAST(c.race_count AS REAL) / t.total_count AS share FROM circuit_counts AS c JOIN total AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM shares) SELECT s.circuitId, s.race_count, s.share, s.share - a.mean_share FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.mean_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.mean_share ORDER BY s.share - a.mean_share DESC LIMIT 10
